statement: Before independent source verification is delegated, Solver presents the complete structurally checkpoint-landable verification surface: exact candidate identity and path scope, same-base rejection supersession obligations, approved-uncheckpointed receipt drift, aggregate identity, and exact-only both eligibility; next blocks incomplete candidates, checkpoint --dry-run exposes the same read-only projection, and canonical steering requires all applicable checklists and behavioral proof up front.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Verifier readiness is derived from a copied in-memory event log and existing checkpoint verification logic; preflight never appends an event, stages a file, changes HEAD, or mutates the worktree.
The pre-verifier gate checks structural checkpoint landability only. Unrelated product and full-audit failures remain visible as advisories and do not broaden this gate.
Reuse checkpoint --dry-run and next; do not add a second preflight command or weaken exact attempt, rejection supersession, checkpoint, or aggregate verification semantics.

Focused tests prove different-base rejection blocking, same-base full-path supersession readiness, older approved-receipt drift visibility, exact fingerprint equality for both eligibility, read-only preflight, and exact next/dry-run dossiers.
